checks: Release/JSON/private publication primitives byte-equivalent AST; transaction engines, guard-relevant control and adoption modules unchanged.
Observation enabled only inside acquired backend lock and after freeze started; only first failure retained.
Exact exception types and literal allowlists only; arbitrary exception text, stdout, stderr, subclass strings and extra helper fields cannot enter the record.
Fixed root0600 failure.json publishes through existing no-replace link+fsync primitive; existing evidence and pending file are not overwritten.
Exact systemd start command is observed without splitting/reordering batches or changing commands/timeouts.
Decorators re-raise original exceptions; publication failure is swallowed to preserve existing restore/hold behavior.
Nonzero governance helper output accepts only strict schema_version/code, fixed membership; other failures become UNKNOWN_FAILURE.
limits: Best-effort evidence: failed publication is not retried and may leave no failure record.
SIGKILL/power loss is outside Python exception observation; a fixed future archival helper must preserve failure.json and any failure.json.next, including the possible link/publication interruption.
No production observation or new activation authority; integrated VM qualification is a separate receipt.
scope: Independent source and AST review of closed diagnostic instrumentation against immutable production controller002; no repeated suite or production execution.
